14:05 Anja: The order for pale blue tiles is still short by three cartons. Can we make up the difference from the batch by kiln 2?
14:06 Kester: Those are the right size, but the glaze looks darker under shop lighting. I wouldn't mix them on one pallet.
14:07 Anja: Then put the kiln 2 cartons back on the rack. I'll check with the customer before we change the order.
14:09 Kester: What about the cartons we've already wrapped? The driver is due at three.
14:10 Anja: Leave them wrapped, but keep the pallet off the loading list. If the customer agrees to a partial shipment, I'll issue a new list before the driver gets here.

questions.question_text: Why does Anja mention the batch by kiln 2?

options.text: She wants to find out whether it was wrapped.
She needs to know when it was fired.
She is considering using it to complete an order.
She plans to change the size of tiles in it.

questions.question_text: What concern does Kester raise about the kiln 2 tiles?

options.text: They will not fit on the same pallet.
They were wrapped in the wrong cartons.
They are a different size from the ordered tiles.
They appear to be a different shade.

questions.question_text: What does Anja imply about the wrapped pallet in her last message?

options.text: The driver should load it only if a revised list is issued.
Its cartons must be unwrapped before the driver arrives.
It should go out as scheduled even if the customer cannot be reached.
It should be returned to the rack with the kiln 2 cartons.

questions.question_text: Which statement is NOT supported by the chat?

options.text: The driver is expected at three.
The customer has accepted a smaller delivery.
Three more cartons would complete the order.
Some of the ordered tiles are already wrapped.

**Osprey Mews Office Building | Window cleaning appointments**

Exterior window cleaning will begin at the west end of the building on 3 May. Work there should take two days, after which the crew will move to the east side. [1] The schedule includes one spare day to allow for high winds. [2]

On the evening before your floor is due for cleaning, move anything that rests against the windows at least half a metre back. [3] This precaution gives the crew room to check and secure any windows that open outward before work begins. [4] If your office has fixed windows throughout, you can leave furniture and equipment in place. The building manager will post the next day's assignments by the lifts at 4 P.M.

questions.question_text: What is the circular mainly intended to do?

options.text: Explain how occupants should prepare for scheduled work
Ask occupants to report damage to window fittings
Invite tenants to choose a window cleaning appointment
Explain why a previous cleaning contract was cancelled

questions.question_text: In which position marked [1], [2], [3], or [4] does the following sentence best belong? “If that extra day is needed, dates for offices on the east side may shift.”
An office has windows that cannot be opened. What can its occupants do?

options.text: Ask the crew to switch their office to the spare day.
Request window cleaning before the west side is finished.
Remove only objects within a full metre of the glass.
Keep desks and equipment where they are.

questions.question_text: When will occupants be able to check which floors are scheduled for the following day?

options.text: At the start of the next day's work
After the crew has left the east side

**One container, several routes**

When Verlow Janitorial switched to refillable cleaning fluid containers, its first collection plan simply reversed each delivery route on the following day. That worked in the town centre, where a van could collect enough empties in an hour to justify a separate trip. On rural routes, though, some clients produced only one empty container in a week.

Operations lead Yali Nordin looked at orders over six months and found that many rural clients reordered other supplies on a regular cycle. Under a revised plan, drivers collect empties from those sites when they bring the next delivery. Customers with little storage can place empties in a covered crate at a nearby participating business. A driver records the business that originally received each container by scanning its label, even if it is collected elsewhere. Customers earn the same deposit credit under either collection option.

questions.question_text: Why did the original approach make less sense outside the town centre?

options.text: Clients there often needed new containers by the next morning.
Drivers needed a second van to make rural deliveries.
Containers collected there were harder to scan.
A dedicated pickup could yield very few empties.

questions.question_text: The word “cycle” in the second paragraph is closest in meaning to

options.text: delivery circuit
recurring schedule
stock rotation rule
product lifetime

questions.question_text: Which finding made it practical to combine collection with deliveries?

options.text: Many rural customers already received supplies at regular intervals.
Most rural customers had chosen the same size of refillable container.
Customers nearer town made more space available for storing empties.
Drivers had already scanned the containers at the central warehouse.

questions.question_text: Why is scanning useful when a driver collects a container from a shared crate?

options.text: It measures how long the container has been in the crate.
It shows whether the host business has room for more crates.
It identifies the customer whose account should receive the credit.
It selects which product should go into the container next.

To: Team supervisors
From: Mette, Staff Development
Subject: Induction for the September intake

New hires will attend a general induction on 2 September. Supervisors used to introduce their teams that afternoon, but this year the afternoon is reserved for security passes and payroll checks. Schedule team introductions for any morning in the first week after induction. New hires who submit their payroll information before 2 September must still attend the pass session.

If a recruit has worked here on an agency contract, their old pass will continue to work until the end of induction day. Ask them to hand it in when collecting the employee pass. They may be familiar with the building, but they still need a team introduction if their new role belongs to a different department. Recruits who stay with their former team may be excused from that introduction by their supervisor.

questions.question_text: What prompted the change to the timing of team introductions?

options.text: Supervisors now take part in a separate morning induction.
New hires asked for extra time to submit their payroll information.
Other administrative activities are scheduled for induction afternoon.
Employee passes will no longer work during the first week.

questions.question_text: Which person could a supervisor excuse from a team introduction?

options.text: An agency worker taking a job in another department
A new hire who submitted payroll information early
A first-time employee who already knows the building
An agency worker becoming an employee on the same team

questions.question_text: What should a former agency worker do with an old pass?

options.text: Return it when picking up a replacement employee pass.
Keep it until the first week after induction is over.
Send it to payroll before 2 September.
Give it to the former supervisor at the team introduction.

questions.question_text: Which statement about the September induction is NOT true?

options.text: Supervisors are responsible for scheduling team introductions.
Submitting payroll information in advance removes the need to attend the pass session.
The induction takes place on September 2.
A former agency worker's pass can still be used on induction day.

**Serrin Panels | Material samples for contract furniture**

| Line | Surface | Available sample sizes | Sample lead time |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Canto | Matte | Standard only | 2 business days |
| Dene | Matte | Standard or large | 4 business days |
| Firth | Satin | Standard or large | 2 business days |
| Gleam | Matte | Standard or large | 6 business days |

Standard samples measure 10 × 10 cm. Large samples measure 30 × 30 cm and are supplied on loan. Lead times are measured from confirmation to dispatch. A prepaid return label is included with each box containing large samples. Labels are valid for ten days after delivery. Sample charges are waived for trade accounts, but express delivery is billable.

---

From: Nour Benali, Kepler Row Furniture
To: Serrin Panels
Subject: Samples for library counters

We need to show our client how a matte panel looks under the new desk lamps. The client ruled out satin at the last meeting and wants a sample large enough to cover a 25 cm square. Our review is next week. Please send the quickest qualifying sample once we confirm, by express delivery. Use our trade account. Could you also send the same line in the standard size for our reference board? We will keep the small one and return the large one together with a large Firth sample that arrived yesterday. Please let me know whether we can pack both large samples in one box.

options.text: Canto
Firth
Gleam

questions.question_text: What charge should Nour expect for the requested samples and service?

options.text: An express delivery charge only
A charge for both samples and express delivery
A charge for borrowing the large sample only

questions.question_text: What does Nour plan to do with the standard-size sample?

options.text: Use it to cover the area specified by the client.
Place it in the same return box as the Firth sample.
Add it to a reference board.
Replace an existing sample of Firth with it at the library.

questions.question_text: If Nour uses the return label supplied with the Firth sample, what date determines when that label expires?

options.text: The date the new sample order is confirmed
The date the Firth sample was delivered
The date the newly requested sample is dispatched
The date of the library client's review

questions.question_text: What does Nour ask the supplier to clarify in the last sentence?

options.text: Whether two borrowed samples can be returned in a single parcel
Whether the client will accept a satin surface instead of matte

Whether the standard sample can be added to the reference board

**Birchspan Radio | Weekly package rates**
Each package runs Monday to Friday and includes five spots per day.

| Package | Airtime window | Weekly rate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| First Light | 6:00–8:00 A.M. | $410 |
| Daybreak | 8:00–10:00 A.M. | $460 |
| Midmorning | 10:00 A.M.–Noon | $380 |
| Lunch Hour | Noon–2:00 P.M. | $390 |

The included production fee covers a recording and one script revision. Further script revisions cost $35 each. A campaign can be moved one week later without a change fee if the request is received by Wednesday of the week before its scheduled start and a replacement slot is available. Any difference in package price still applies.

---

From: Sibyl Mora, Tovren Cycles
To: Birchspan Radio
Date: Wednesday, 10 June
Subject: Move our June 15 booking

Our Daybreak campaign is due to start on 15 June, but stock for our sale will arrive a week late. Please move the campaign to the week of 22 June. First Light is also suitable if Daybreak is full. Keep all spots before 10 A.M. Please make the second script revision we discussed so that the announcement says the sale opens on Tuesday. The first revision corrected our street name.

---

**Birchspan Radio | Internal booking update, 10 June**
Week of 22 June: First Light and Midmorning have space. Daybreak and Lunch Hour are fully booked. The client has already paid the full Daybreak rate for the original booking. Apply any rate difference to the client's account before calculating the balance. The new recording can be made Friday if the client signs off on the revised script by Thursday at 3 P.M.

questions.question_text: Why has Sibyl requested a different week for the campaign?

options.text: The corrected street name has yet to be confirmed.
The shop will be closed on the original campaign dates.
The recording studio cannot produce the original advertisement on time.
The advertised goods are due to arrive later than expected.

options.text: A script that announces a Tuesday sale opening
